newsitem.title: CHILE: El Abra copper output may rise to 250,000 tns '97.
newsitem.headline: El Abra copper output may rise to 250,000 tns '97.

text.p: Chile's recently opened El Abra copper mine expects production to rise to 250,000 tonnes of cathodes next year from its scheduled 225,000 tonnes, said general manager Jorge von Loebenstein.
Asked when the expansion to 250,000 tonnes would take place, he replied, "I hope during next year."
He said, "We have a commitment to produce 225,000 tonnes next year. And if we produce 250,000 tonnes, so much the better."
Von Loebenstein said the plant, which started production in August, had a built-in 10 percent expansion capacity.
The mine near the northern city of Calama has already produced 24,000 tonnes of cathodes, with an early copper recovery rate of more than 75 percent, he detailed.
